usage: The word '蝴蝶' is a noun and refers to the insect butterfly.
'蝴蝶' can be used to describe real butterflies or things that resemble butterflies.
You can use '蝴蝶' in simple sentences as the subject or object.
It is common to see '蝴蝶' in descriptions related to nature and seasons.
When you want to talk about multiple butterflies, you can say '好多蝴蝶' (many butterflies).
